description: This source file defines a set of functions for making HTTP API calls to a backend server, primarily focused on RESTful endpoints such as /api/users, /api/session-tracking, /api/app-deployments, and other specific analytical endpoints. It includes utility functions for URL building, query parameter sanitation, response parsing, and methods providing a high-level API client interface.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Detects if a given URL string is an absolute URL (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Joins a base URL with a relative path or handles absolute URLs accordingly, avoiding double slashes.

methods.name: toQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Converts an object of parameters into a URL query string.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Checks if the provided path or URL pertains to the session-tracking root endpoint.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams(pathOrUrl, params = {})
methods.description: Sanitizes query parameters based on specific API endpoint rules, e.g., /api/users, /api/session-tracking, /api/llm-costs.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams(pathOrUrl, params = {})
methods.description: Ensures necessary scoping parameters like organization_id or tenant_id are included in the request query params based on endpoint.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams(pathOrUrl, effParams)
methods.description: Builds a URL with query parameters, merging with existing URL query if present.

methods.name: parseResponse(res)
methods.description: Parses fetch responses, returning a standardized object with ok, status, and payload.

methods.name: httpGet(pathOrUrl, { params, headers, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request with scoped and sanitized query parameters, returning parsed JSON data.

methods.name: httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal, params } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP method (POST, PUT, DELETE) request with a JSON body and scoped query parameters.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload(payload)
methods.description: Normalizes list payload responses into an object with items, total, and meta keys.

methods.name: getApiClient()
methods.description: Provides an axios-like API client with get/post/put/delete methods.

methods.name: health()
methods.description: Checks backend health status.

methods.name: listUsers(params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users, formatted with total, items, and meta, using /api/users.

methods.name: listSessions(params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves session tracking records with tenant_id scope via /api/session-tracking.

methods.name: listDeployments(params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of app deployments from /api/app-deployments.

methods.name: listDashboardUsersAnalytics(params = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches aggregated user analytics data from /api/dashboard/users.

methods.name: listLlmCosts(params = {})
methods.description: Lists LLM costs from /api/llm-costs, using legacy route.

methods.name: listLlmCostsUnderscore(params = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Lists LLM costs from /api/llm_costs, supporting detailed response envelope.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummaryStrict()
methods.description: Fetches tenant user summary ensuring only organization_id is sent.

ctags.name: httpJson
ctags.pattern: /^async function httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal, params } = {}) {$/
